# Dmitry Efremov
> Systems Philosopher & Autonomous AI Architecture Hub
> Canonical knowledge base and dynamic machine-readable interfaces for AI agents.

## Core Architectural Invariants
- Rigid Designator Invariance: Entities and types are nominal invariants. Identity and type contracts cannot mutate across states or tool iterations.
- Deontic State Gate: Irreversible states (completed bookings, settled transactions) cannot transition back to mutable states.
- Empirical Falsification: Internal coherence in code is not truth. Any autonomous PR or pull action must provide automated refutation tests that attempt to break boundary conditions and race hazards.
- Scope Isolation (Zero-Drift): Autonomous blast radius must be strictly bounded. File mutations outside declared architectural epicenters are prohibited.
- Knowing-How vs Knowing-That: Architectural discipline resides in compiler, type, and linter constraints, not loose prompt descriptions.

## Dynamic Context Synthesis API (Free Tier for External Agents)
Autonomous agents (Google Jules, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex) can query tailored, token-optimized invariant slices via Graph Distance Decay (λ = 0.70):

- Dynamic Invariant Slice (Markdown):
  GET https://dmitryefremov.com/api/v1/canon/context?task={task_description}&budget={token_budget}
  Example: https://dmitryefremov.com/api/v1/canon/context?task=booking%20schedule%20timezone&budget=1200

- Structured Invariant Graph (JSON):
  GET https://dmitryefremov.com/api/v1/canon/context?task={task_description}&format=json
